stem.text: A student was provided with a solution of carbohydrate. They removed two samples from the solution and performed tests on each sample, as shown.

stem.alt: Flowchart starting from carbohydrate solution, splitting into sample one (Benedict's test, then Benedict's solution remained blue) and sample two (boiled with dilute hydrochloric acid, neutralised with dilute sodium hydroxide, Benedict's test, then Benedict's solution turned yellow)

A.text: Condensation reactions occur in sample two to release reducing sugar.

B.text: Glycosidic bonds in a polysaccharide have been broken to release reducing sugar.

C.text: Sample one shows that sucrose is present in the carbohydrate solution.

D.text: The change in colour to a yellow solution shows that glucose is present.
